rows.text: Price-snapshot store with opening and closing numbers for every market originated.
rows.evidence: Immutable snapshot store with 14 retained captures; the ledger derives opening/latest/closing/post-hoc per event × market under a pre-registered policy, and 52 cells show a genuine opening-to-latest interval.
rows.number: 78 of 816 market cells have a pre-kickoff opening and 52 have moved; clearance needs a captured interval for every cell a strategy grades.

rows.text: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all.
rows.evidence: Results feed reconciles to official standings on 160/160 club × field checks over 149 played games.
rows.number: 160 of 160 checks must match — currently met.

rows.text: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline.
rows.evidence: Three separate fits in that order; each market is graded before the next is trusted; the moneyline is explicitly a transform of the margin model's residual scale.
rows.number: Order is enforced by construction and asserted in tests.

rows.text: Publish fair line, market line and difference as separate columns.
rows.evidence: Every game row on the lines page carries model spread, market spread and difference, and the same three columns for the total.
rows.number: Every played game row has all three columns or an explicit blank.

rows.text: Separate signal from staking so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal.
rows.evidence: Leaderboard ranks on Brier skill with an interval; win rate appears in its own columns with a Wilson interval; no ROI column exists anywhere.
rows.number: 0 ROI rankings published; all ranks are proper-score based.

rows.text: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement.
rows.evidence: 149 rank-1 slots hold ≥2 players; the graph keeps the published group and measures playing time, but no official source names an assignment.
rows.gate: G07 joint evidence (not applicable) / missing official assignment
rows.number: Clear when an official source names the starter for a slot; today 9 of 254 report rows even carry a game designation.

rows.text: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value.
rows.evidence: 2 official-input correlations published with n and a Fisher-z interval; 4 withheld with a written reason.
rows.number: Every published value has n and a 95% interval.

rows.text: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper.
rows.evidence: Gate G10 demotes any strategy whose Brier-skill interval is entirely below zero. It demoted 3: S01, S02, S03.
rows.number: 3 strategies demoted on this build.

rows.text: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from appearing on the leaderboard.
rows.evidence: 10 rules registered with a content hash; blocked rules are excluded from every score rather than shown as untested.
rows.number: Every strategy row displays the hash it scored under.

rows.text: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset.
rows.evidence: 1,386 slots, 1,745 named players, 254 report rows, 543 reserve rows and 13,913 playing-time rows, each with a source.
rows.number: Every node carries a source URL; missing edges are listed.

rows.text: Do not model depth from jersey order; model it from playing time.
rows.evidence: Depth order is compared with measured snap share in 516 groups; disagreement is published, not resolved.
rows.number: 0 depth rows derived from jersey number, experience or salary.

rows.text: Make the injury signal a surprise, never a level.
rows.evidence: A surprise needs a dated series to take a baseline from. Exactly one official report capture is held, so a baseline cannot be formed without lookahead.
rows.number: Clear at ≥5 dated captures per week for 4 consecutive weeks.

rows.text: Run the 32-team roster and reserve sweep before any team-level model is trusted.
rows.evidence: Reserve list read for 32 clubs / 543 players from the roster release; the official transaction log is not held.
rows.number: Clear when all 32 clubs' reserve status is confirmed against official pages.

rows.text: Fixture-context features built only from published schedule facts.
rows.evidence: Rest, roof, surface, temperature, wind, division flag and kickoff are carried on every fixture row from the schedule release; no derived value is passed off as published.
rows.number: Every context field traces to the schedule release.

rows.text: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs, not just a pick.
rows.evidence: Every row stores the ratings, home-field term, residual scale and the resulting probability for all three markets, for both estimators.
rows.number: Every probability row names its inputs.

rows.text: Compute and publish the removal-of-luck panel on the site.
rows.evidence: Sample-size arithmetic, Wilson intervals, paired bootstrap skill intervals and an exact binomial tail for every scored rule, on 149 games.
rows.number: Every strategy carries an interval and a fluke probability.

rows.text: Two-sided 'what would change our mind' field on every strategy entry.
rows.evidence: Every registered strategy has a promote condition and a kill condition, and the kill condition is executed by gate G10.
rows.number: 10 of 10 entries carry both fields.

rows.text: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule.
rows.evidence: Residuals published for every played game (side 13.383 pts sd, total 13.992 pts sd). The schedule runs on every build, but pre-kickoff publication needs a capture before kickoff, which only the unplayed Week 10 slate has.
rows.number: 78 cells have a pre-kickoff number and 52 show movement; clearance needs a captured interval for every graded cell.

rows.text: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus.
rows.evidence: 149 played games, reconciled. Every strategy is scored on the same corpus with the same benchmarks, and each row says which price class it used.
rows.number: 149 games available; 136 was the target.

rows.text: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published.
rows.evidence: A ten-point policy is committed with a content hash written into the ledger, covering opening versus closing, post-hoc exclusion, vig removal, push handling, settlement and time zones.
rows.number: Policy hash present in the ledger and checked on every build.

rows.text: Store every injury-hub read with its clock time and publish the delta, never the level.
rows.evidence: Each capture carries an observation timestamp and SHA-256; the drift page publishes row-level deltas between captures rather than an aggregate count.
rows.number: Clear at ≥2 captures per week across 4 weeks so deltas form a series.

rows.text: Decision-readiness table: one row per requirement, its blocking gate and the clearing number.
rows.evidence: This page. 33 requirements, each with state, evidence, gate and the measurable number.
rows.number: Every row carries a gate or an explicit 'n/a' plus a number.

rows.text: Ingest game-level results to make ratings opponent-aware.
rows.evidence: Ratings are fitted on margins, so strength of schedule is implicit; the Elo estimator makes the opponent adjustment explicit and is published beside the ridge fit.
rows.number: Two estimators, both opponent-aware, both published with their residuals.

rows.text: Injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties.
rows.evidence: Ablation with and without the personnel term on a chronological holdout: MAE improvement 0.04 [-0.185, 0.102].
rows.number: Interval published; no fixed penalty is used anywhere.

rows.text: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts.
rows.evidence: Snap counts are held and used (community). Official inactive lists are not held: the report publishes 6 game designations in total, so an active list cannot be reconstructed.
rows.number: Clear when official inactive lists are captured for every played game of the evaluation window.

rows.text: Fix the depth-parsing failures before widening coverage.
rows.evidence: The two known failures are recorded, not papered over: the Packers' jersey-number prefix is stripped and the raw string retained; the Texans' image chart has no structured source and stays unparsed.
rows.number: 30/32 clubs parsed; clearance needs 32/32 with a structured source.

rows.text: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter.
rows.evidence: 149 rank-1 slots hold more than one player and are kept as groups; no slot is reduced to one name.
rows.number: 0 slots collapsed to a single starter.

rows.text: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event.
rows.evidence: Reserve/inactive status is read per player and joined to slots; the official transaction log with dates is not held, so turnover cannot yet be versioned against a roster event.
rows.number: Clear when the official transactions log is captured with dates and joined to the graph.

rows.text: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline, frozen and recorded before kickoff.
rows.evidence: 4 singles rules are frozen and scored; recording before kickoff needs a pre-kickoff capture, which exists for only part of the Week 10 slate.
rows.number: Clear when a shadow forecast is logged before every kickoff for 4 weeks.

rows.text: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate.
rows.evidence: Both combo strategies are registered as BLOCKED with the reason; neither is scored and neither is described as promising.
rows.gate: G07 joint evidence + G08 settlement rules
rows.number: 0 combos ranked; clearance needs a validated joint probability and operator rules.

rows.text: Proper-score leaderboard divisions for singles, parlays, SGP and prop combos.
rows.evidence: Every leaderboard row carries its family (singles / controls / parlays / player-props) and the divisions are never pooled into one rank.
rows.number: Family label on every row.

rows.text: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate.
rows.evidence: Ranking is Brier skill with a paired game-cluster bootstrap; the multiplicity adjustment covers 10 trials.
rows.number: alpha per test 0.00500.

rows.text: Durable snapshot storage and alerts for source/schema change.
rows.evidence: Snapshots are immutable and hashed and the build is deterministic. Freshness alerting exists only as a build-time gate, not as a monitored service.
rows.number: Clear when a scheduled capture records misses and a drift alarm fires on a changed row count.

rows.text: Split the public analysis layer from a private data layer.
rows.evidence: The site publishes derived analysis and links to official pages; raw row-level data lives in repository data folders. Terms of reuse are not established, so this is not yet a rights split.
rows.number: Clear when written reuse terms exist for each source class.

rows.text: Per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count.
rows.evidence: Per-club lost snap share and unavailable players are computed for 30 clubs; 'replacements named' stays blank because no official source names one.
rows.number: Clear when an official source names the replacement, not just the next published name.

rows.text: Announced-starter evidence field rather than an inferred replacement.
rows.evidence: No announced-starter source is held. The field exists and is blank by rule.
rows.number: Clear when dated club announcements are captured and linked.

rows.text: Official depth-chart register with date and source per row.
rows.evidence: 1,386 depth rows, each carrying its club URL, capture hash and observation timestamp.
rows.number: Every row has date + source; 30/32 clubs covered.

rows.text: Calibrate what 'Questionable' means empirically instead of using old percentages.
rows.evidence: The captured report carries 9 game designations in total across 254 rows; there is no inactive list to join against.
rows.number: Clear when designations are joined to official inactive lists over several seasons with CIs.

rows.text: Interactive offense/defense deficiency matrix (1st-4th string) on one screen.
rows.evidence: The deficiency view lists each Week 10 rank-1 slot with an official Out/Doubtful designation and the club's next published name. '4th string' is usually unpublished — 500 of 676 position groups in the repository's earlier count have no third string.
rows.number: Clear when a defender-side join and a published 3rd string exist for the matchup.

rows.text: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log.
rows.evidence: No official transactions log is held, so staleness cannot be dated against a roster event.
rows.number: Clear when the transactions log is captured with dates.

rows.text: Point-in-time snapshot ledger for injuries, depth and inactives.
rows.evidence: Every capture carries a timestamp and hash and is stored immutably; the series is one deep, so point-in-time replay is possible but has nothing to replay against.
rows.number: Clear at ≥2 dated captures per week across a full month.

rows.text: Re-capture and republish the Week 10 injury tables when the source changes.
rows.evidence: The drift page publishes row-level differences between captures and never reconciles them by inference; the captured tables are those of 2026-11-12.
rows.number: Clear when every capture in a week is retained and diffed.

rows.text: Reject deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary.
rows.evidence: No such derivation exists in this workspace; depth order comes only from the club page, and measured order comes only from playing time.
rows.number: 0 inferred depth rows; asserted in tests.

rows.text: Represent shared and empty depth slots faithfully.
rows.evidence: 149 shared rank-1 slots are kept as groups; an empty slot stays empty.
rows.number: 0 slots silently collapsed or filled.

rows.text: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature.
rows.evidence: Requires several seasons of designations joined to official inactive lists. Neither archive is held.
rows.number: Clear when play rate per designation is measured with confidence intervals over ≥3 seasons.

rows.text: Snapshot the official report on Wed/Thu/Fri (and daily to kickoff) with a dated history.
rows.evidence: The repository holds single captures, not a schedule of them. The capture script exists; the schedule does not yet run against the official page.
rows.number: Clear at 3 captures per week for 4 consecutive weeks, each hashed and retained.

rows.text: Use snap counts as the starter proxy when the depth chart is unavailable.
rows.evidence: Playing-time leaders are computed for 516 club/unit/position groups and published beside the published order.
rows.number: Both orders published; disagreement is the datum.

rows.text: Control baseline (random picks; favourites only) on every leaderboard run.
rows.evidence: 4 control arms are scored on the same rows as every model rule, with BSS exactly 0 by construction.
rows.number: Every leaderboard run includes the controls.

rows.text: Stadium roof, surface and weather context for totals and passing props.
rows.evidence: Roof, surface, temperature and wind are carried from the schedule release. No official hourly NWS forecast grid is held, so a forecast-versus-game-time overlay does not exist.
rows.number: Clear when a dated forecast grid is captured beside the official roof designation.

rows.text: Two-stage skill leaderboard: proper-score qualification, then prospective CLV and ROI.
rows.evidence: Stage one runs. Stage two cannot: CLV needs a pre-kickoff close, which gate G05 blocks.
rows.number: Clear when pre-kickoff closes exist for a full evaluation window.

rows.text: Vig-free market consensus versus originated fair-line decomposition.
rows.evidence: Two-way vig removal is implemented and applied to the stored moneyline, and the residual is published. A multi-book consensus cannot be computed from a single, book-less price.
rows.number: Clear when two or more independent prices per market exist.

rows.text: Weekly 'what changed' diff rather than a static snapshot.
rows.evidence: Deltas are published between the captures that exist. A weekly series needs weekly captures.
rows.number: Clear at one capture per week across a month, diffed.

rows.text: Publish every model total twice until one wins on a walk-forward comparison.
rows.evidence: The ridge total and the Elo-derived total are both published with their residuals; neither is collapsed into the other.
rows.number: Both estimators on every row.

rows.text: A drift alarm on every scraper: expected row counts and required fields.
rows.evidence: The build fails closed when a required artifact is missing or a reconciliation breaks; the capture scripts do not yet pin per-source row-count expectations.
rows.number: Clear when each capture records its expected row count and fails on a miss.

rows.text: Capture the reserve list so 'not listed' never means 'available'.
rows.evidence: 543 reserve/inactive players are read per club and joined to the availability graph.
rows.number: Reserve status is a node in the graph, not an assumption.

rows.text: Reject ranking strategies by season-long ROI.
rows.evidence: No ROI column exists. Ranking is proper-score based, and the luck page shows why realised return cannot separate skill from variance at this sample.
rows.number: 0 ROI-based ranks published.

rows.text: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons.
rows.evidence: No official historical injury-report archive is held. nflverse publishes a community injury release, which is not official and cannot satisfy this requirement.
rows.number: Clear when a dated official archive is captured with per-week hashes.

rows.text: Pre-register each strategy with a frozen definition before results are seen.
rows.evidence: Content hashes on every rule; gate G02 checks presence; the leaderboard displays the hash.
rows.number: All registered rules hashed.

rows.text: Freeze a rule before it sees data; the commit hash is the registration.
rows.evidence: Registrations are committed before scoring runs in the same build, and the hash covers the rule text, the market and the threshold.
rows.number: Hash present for every strategy.

rows.text: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons.
rows.evidence: The walk-forward design fits only on prior seasons, and the ablation has a chronological holdout of weeks 7-10. A season-level three-way split cannot be honoured on a single-season corpus.
rows.number: Clear when at least three seasons of pre-kickoff prices exist.

rows.text: 2026 kickoff and declared onside-kick regime priors filter.
rows.evidence: Rule changes are documented in the rulebook, but no prior filter is fitted or validated; inventing a coefficient would be a fixed penalty, which the brief rejects.
rows.number: Clear when a rule-change indicator is tested as an ablation with an interval.

rows.text: Suggestions live in a dedicated review section so a path can be chosen before building.
rows.evidence: 9 suggestions ranked by what they unblock, each with cost, risk and the decision it needs.
rows.number: Every suggestion names the requirements it unblocks.
